title: Creation
definition: Creation is God's free and sovereign act of bringing all things into existence by His will and Word, making heaven and earth and everything in them for His glory.
summary: The doctrine of creation teaches that everything exists because God willed it, spoke it, and sustains it. Creation is not independent, accidental, or self-originating. God is distinct from creation yet actively Lord over it. Because God created all things, every human life has dignity, every part of creation belongs to Him, and all things are accountable to His purpose and glory.
christFocus: All things were created through Christ and for Christ. He is not merely part of creation; He is Creator, Sustainer, and Redeemer, holding all things together by His power.

studySections.heading: God Created by His Word
studySections.content: Scripture presents creation as the result of God's command and will. God speaks, and creation obeys.

studySections.heading: Creation Displays God's Glory
studySections.content: The heavens and the earth bear witness to God's power, wisdom, beauty, and majesty.

studySections.heading: Creation Belongs to God
studySections.content: Because God made all things, all creation is accountable to Him and exists for His purpose.
